categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and property rights. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and title settlement, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
